== Usage ==
{{ItemInfo
|type = Sword
|name = Sting
|rarity = l
|damage = 150
|crit_damage = 40
|strength = 75
|special_effect = Deal {{Stat|Damage|+300%}} to and gain {{stat|combat wisdom|+45}} against {{mt|Arthropod}} mobs.
|item_ability_name = Webcutter
|item_ability_description = This weapon can be used to clear webs left by the [[Tarantula Broodfather|{{Dark Red|Tarantula Broodfather}}]]!
|item_ability_name2 = Stinger

The '''Sting''' grants a {{stat|dmg|+300%}} bonus to and {{Stat|combat wisdom|+45}} against {{mt|Arthropod}} mobs. It has {{Green|2}} abilities:

* {{AN|Webcutter}} allows the '''Sting''' to break webs left by the {{MobSprite|Tarantula Broodfather}}'s {{AN|Web of Lies}} ability.
* {{AN|Stinger}} causes all attacks to crit, as if affected by {{Stat|cc}}.
